notes: Provenance, field by field. PRICES and stated_expiry come from the act itself, read as a PDF at minfin.gov.by/upload/dragmet/gosfond/actual_fizlitca.pdf (appendix Table 1; point 3 reads 'Настоящее постановление вступает в силу после его официального опубликования и действует по 31 июля 2026 г.'). Note that URL is a rolling one - 'actual' - and will point at the successor act once one is published, so it is not a stable citation for this act. ACT_NUMBER and ACT_DATE come only from the appendix heading on the prices page, '08.07.2026 № 31'; the PDF is the unsigned publication form, with both the number and the date fields left blank. EFFECTIVE_FROM is stated twice by the Ministry itself: on the prices page directly above Table 1 ('Вступает в силу с 18 июля 2026 года') and in the news headline 'Цены ... с 18 июля 2026 г.'. It is deliberately not the act date. 08.07.2026 is when the Minister signed it; the act defers its own commencement to official publication, which is a separate and later event (inclusion in the National Legal Register). Point 2 of the act corroborates the gap: it repeals resolution № 27 of 18.06.2026, and that repeal only takes effect when this act does, so № 27 governed 8-17 July and the two do not overlap. The prices were confirmed twice, from the PDF and from the HTML table, independently. transcribed_by is still not a person: someone should read the act and put their own name there before this record counts as vouched for.
